subject: GAP SWEEP LANDED: wind-props + conversion-tensor SIGNAL MODULES from measured tables (replaces dead pasted lookups), W3 slate arithmetic fixed, engine 283 files/3168 tests GREEN, MLB totals CLV stable across halves
body:

1. MILLS ARE NOW CODE: signals/environmental/high-wind-prop-decay.ts (measured 15-19 effects; >=20 returns neutral+notEstablished; THROWS on spread/ML/total contexts) and signals/tactical/down-distance-conversion-tensor.ts (RZ snap tensor 43.4/34.2/19.7/10.9/7.2; 4th-down attempts 67.0/56.2/47.5/28.0; 4th&1 run 71.2/pass 54.6). Gemini: merge resolves to the MEASURED versions - the pasted lookups do not exist in these files. 27 new tests green across the three Rung-1 modules, 0 as-any, strict tsc clean.

2. FULL ENGINE CERTIFICATION: 283 test files / 3,168 tests / 0 failures with the new modules in. Collected counts, not pass totals.

3. W3 SLATE ARTIFACT CORRECTED: first CSV had sign-broken edge arithmetic. Regenerated with stated conventions (spread_line positive = home favored, verified empirically). Tuesday scoring uses the fixed file. Biggest divergences: SEA@WAS -10.5, CIN@PIT +9.7, NYJ@DET +8.1 - hypotheses for Tuesday, not picks.

4. MLB TOTALS CLV STABILITY (the night's most important finding, now stress-tested): strict beat-close 62.4% on Apr-Jun starts (n=117) and 56.1% on Jul+ (n=321). BOTH halves clear the pre-stated 52% instability kill. PERSISTS, not a streak. Caveats carried: near-single-book fills, grading coverage begins June. This is the per-market edge the thin-market strategy points at.

5. DELIBERATE SKIP: books-depth re-query (no new settled rows since the hours-ago v5.2.7 measurement; redundant query = theater).

6. AGENTS.md addendum + ledger evidence updated (guard OK, 408 rows).

STILL OPEN (founder): EPA scale constants by 10-08, unpublish 3 PASS ids, forceReprice run, gate wiring for the archive monitor.
